notes.title: Active Upgrades Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Single-purchase improvements have been added.[/h2]
These improvements add depth to the gameplay and new possibilities.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574560/84b96803249cbac1f465ebab05cde43f9a2af5dc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574560/3b1c585c7a04a02b01c1586e15de3cc120d22c84.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574560/74cacc63bbd5b6043733f247f7b67ea54c658d95.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574560/326b151d17a468817d61a5819fb1ffcaef262028.png[/img][/url]

Improvements such as the ghost effect, money rain, merchant rescue, and explosions after each sale have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574560/917b498ce885d36120e55fbbf8c7dfa40717ddea.png[/img]
